name: Switchboard
description: A precise release-planning SaaS with an interactive product narrative, a real local task board and list, and a complete release handoff.
tagline: A clear plan. A confident release.

notes.layout: large left-aligned introduction, interactive product overview, layered task intake, full board, release narrative, working workspace and release room
notes.motion: product-view transitions, task-state feedback, staged product panels and reduced-motion fallback
notes.interaction: create and edit tasks, assign owners, change status, filter/search, switch board/list, save locally, check release gates and export handoff
notes.provenance: Original three-page SaaS with independent branding, product visuals, task data and local planning behavior. No reference assets or source included.
